title: cfs breakthrough
description: An editorial feature on a flat tan field: a big light title with an orange edge tick, then numbered figures on a four-column grid (a wide 3:2 photo over three columns and a small one in the fourth, both with a 3px orange bottom rule, and a frameless line drawing bleeding off the right edge), a long paragraph set in two columns under the big photo, and a ring-arrow link. On phones the text comes first and the figures pair up below it.
notes: three media slots: figure 1 and 2 are photos (3:2), figure 3 is line art (1.37:1) that bleeds past the right edge
the section clips sideways (overflow-x-clip) so the bleeding figure never makes the page scroll
